an5.57:1.1: pañcimāni bhikkhave ṭhānāni abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbāni itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:1.3: jarādhammomhi jaraṃ anatītoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:1.4: byādhidhammomhi byādhiṃ anatītoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:1.5: maraṇadhammomhi maraṇaṃ anatītoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:1.6: sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:1.8: yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā
an5.57:1.9: tassa dāyādo bhavissāmīti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:2.1: kiñca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca jarādhammomhi jaraṃ anatītoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:2.2: atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ yobbane yobbanamado yena madena sattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti manasā duccaritaṃ caranti
an5.57:2.3: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo yobbane yobbanamado so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti
an5.57:2.4: idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca jarādhammomhi jaraṃ anatītoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:3.1: kiñca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca byādhidhammomhi byādhiṃ anatītoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:3.2: atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ ārogye ārogyamado yena madena sattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti manasā duccaritaṃ caranti
an5.57:3.3: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo ārogye ārogyamado so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti
an5.57:3.4: idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca byādhidhammomhi byādhiṃ anatītoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:4.1: kiñca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca maraṇadhammomhi maraṇaṃ anatītoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:4.2: atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ jīvite jīvitamado yena madena sattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti manasā duccaritaṃ caranti
an5.57:4.3: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo jīvite jīvitamado so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti
an5.57:4.4: idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca maraṇadhammomhi maraṇaṃ anatītoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:5.1: kiñca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvoti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:5.2: atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ piyesu chandarāgo yena rāgena sattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti manasā duccaritaṃ caranti
an5.57:5.3: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo piyesu chandarāgo so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti
an5.57:5.4: idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvoti abhiṇhaṃ pacvekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:6.1: kiñca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca kammassakomhi kammadāyādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi
an5.57:6.2: kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāyādo bhavissāmīti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā
an5.57:6.3: atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ
an5.57:6.4: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato sabbaso vā duccaritaṃ pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti
an5.57:6.5: idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca kammassakomhi kammadāyādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi
an5.57:6.7: tassa dāyādo bhavissāmīti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:7.1: sa kho so bhikkhave ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.57:7.2: na kho ahaññeveko jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā jarādhammā jaraṃ anatītāti
an5.57:7.3: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati
an5.57:7.4: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti
an5.57:7.5: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti anusayā byantī honti.
an5.57:8.1: na kho ahaññeveko byādhidhammo byādhiṃ anatīto athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā byādhidhammā byādhiṃ anatītāti
an5.57:8.2: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati
an5.57:8.3: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti
an5.57:8.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti anusayā byantī honti.
an5.57:9.1: na kho ahaññeveko maraṇadhammo maraṇaṃ anatīto athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā maraṇadhammā maraṇaṃ anatītāti
an5.57:9.2: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati
an5.57:9.3: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti
an5.57:9.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti anusayā byantī honti.
an5.57:10.1: na kho mayhevekassa sabbehi piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvoti
an5.57:10.2: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati
an5.57:10.3: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti
an5.57:10.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti anusayā byantī honti.
an5.57:11.1: na kho ahaññeveko kammassakomhi kammadāyādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāyādo bhavissāmi
an5.57:11.2: athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā kammassakā kammadāyādā kammayonī kammabandhū kammapaṭisaraṇā yaṃ kammaṃ karissanti kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāyādā bhavissantīti
an5.57:11.3: tassa taṇṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati
an5.57:11.4: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti
an5.57:11.5: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti anusayā byantī hontīti.
